candidate.init: p4.1 arm B encoder loaded from the pinned p4.2 reconstruction bundle

read_scaffold.role: training-only per-slot head on object_z; never at evaluation
read_scaffold.input: state object representation object_z [branches, 3, 8], branch mean
read_scaffold.matching: exact minimum over the 6 slot permutations
read_scaffold.labels: visible palette objects from the public image: dominant colour per column, mean column x binned left/middle/right; 0 to 3 pairs per example

criteria.read_early_stop: stop stage 1 when train and fit pair accuracy are both >=0.95 and fit set accuracy >=0.80; stop at the second dose when fit pair accuracy is <=0.35 at both doses
criteria.read_blind_rule: if stage 1 is read_still_blind, skip stage 2; the p4.2 card already measured the blind-read to chance byte-head link
criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.correction_protocol: first pass on fit; for every first-pass error release the correct answer and take 8 Adam updates at the feedback lr; re-ask the same input once
criteria.feedback_joint_rule: correction >=0.80 and stability losses <= max(1, 10% of first-pass correct) and gain >=0.05
criteria.control_arm: same trained subject, same feedback exposure, zero parameter updates and zero state writes
criteria.recovery: save the trained bundle, reload in an independent process, re-ask all 32; outputs must be byte-identical
criteria.parent_candidate: read gate plus byte-path main gate plus joint feedback rule plus recovery, on development fit only

stop_conditions.budget: cpu_cap or wall_cap reached -> budget_stop, keep every checkpoint and report the last dose
stop_conditions.read: read gate fails at the final dose -> close as read_still_blind or read_partial without stage 2
stop_conditions.engineering: non-finite gradient, bundle mismatch, cache replay mismatch, or source pin mismatch -> engineering_failure

price_measured.note: one loaded-machine run; the read curve to 3688 steps is 1613.5 CPU and dominates the estimate

read_baselines.note: published beside the read gate so neither chance nor a constant predictor can be mistaken for the read learning

authorization.asked: 是否授权执行 22.5.P4.3（读层对象级稠密监督 1844/3688 步 + 条件性字节头 1844 步 + 纠正/恢复，实测帽 2000 CPU／4000 wall）
authorization.scope: development fit only; no check or final read; no capability claim; parent candidate only
authorization.note: contract frozen with a measured cap; the run is blocked until training_authority is filled by the owner

note: pre-registration and price frozen; the run needs owner authority; no optimizer step has been taken under this contract

scoping.why_this_card: P4.2 closed byte_path_blocks with the read at chance (fit pair 0.3125 to 0.34375); the dense identity-label rule that worked for the encoder in P4.1 is applied to the object read
scoping.what_it_can_claim: development-fit parent candidate only; no A retention, no three-seed bound, no check2
scoping.closure_rule: if the read stays blind at the second dose, the column branch closes with a named negative and 22.6 stays at the fixture layer
